description: This file contains implementation related to voltage measurement, including functions for retrieving voltage reference and battery voltage in an engine control context.

methods.name: getVRef
methods.description: Returns the voltage reference value; currently not used and returns NaN.

methods.name: hasVBatt
methods.description: Checks if the battery voltage channel is configured.

methods.name: getVBatt
methods.description: Calculates and returns the battery voltage by reading the ADC channel and applying a divider coefficient.
